title: 2D Marketing Artist

company.name: Tripledot Studios
company.blurb: London casual games studio (Woodoku, Solitaire, Puzzletime), profitable and scaling paid UA.

description_md:
Who are we?

**TripledotStudios** is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who **LOVE** making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

**The role is working within our studio: LudiosAbout Ludios**

Ludios takes its name from Latin; it means "The Game People". Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games.

Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in.

Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about.

If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you.

**Role Overview**

As a 2D Marketing Artist, you’ll create eye-catching static and 2D assets that bring our games to life across marketing channels. You’ll work closely with Creative, Marketing, Motion, and Playable teams to turn game art into engaging creatives, iterate quickly based on feedback, and deliver high-quality work on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Own the team’s static and 2D marketing art production, from brief to final delivery.

- Create static ads, store assets, ASO creatives, and promotional artwork across different marketing channels.

- Adapt existing game art into polished, engaging marketing compositions while maintaining the game’s visual style.

- Work closely with Motion Designers and Playable Developers to provide and adapt the 2D assets they need.

- Produce rapid creative variations for testing, iteration, and performance optimisation.

- Maintain strong visual consistency and quality across marketing assets and ensure they align with the game’s visual identity.

- Collaborate with Creative, Marketing, and Game teams to understand briefs, incorporate feedback, and deliver assets on time and to a high standard.

**Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

- 2+ years of professional experience in the game industry.

- Strong 2D art and composition skills, with a good understanding of visual hierarchy, layout, colour, and storytelling.

- Plus point if you have any experience creating static marketing creatives, promotional artwork, store assets, or ASO-related visuals.

- Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced, iterative environment and deliver work within agreed timelines.

- Able to communicate clearly, understand briefs, and share ideas effectively.

- Proactive and solution-oriented, comfortable taking ownership of tasks and asking the right questions when requirements are unclear.

- Comfortable receiving and implementing feedback, with the ability to iterate quickly while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

**Working at Tripledot**

- **Hybrid Working**

- **20 days of remote working:** Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year.

- **Regular company events and rewards: **Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements, and our team spirit.

- **Breakfast & Lunch:** Relish daily breakfast and lunch provided in the office to keep you fueled and focused.

- **BPJS HEALTH:** Elevate your well-being and peace of mind, ensuring robust health security with seamless enrolment in BPJS Health.

- **BPJS SOCIAL: **Secure your employment rights with BPJS Social.

- **Festivity Allowance: **Celebrate festive occasions with an additional festive allowance.

- **Private Health Insurance: **Stay covered with comprehensive health insurance for you and your loved ones.

- **Employee Assistance Program:** Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand.

- **Family Forming Support:** Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy]

- **English Classes:** Enhance your English skills with our provided English classes

title: Performance Creative Strategy Lead, Paid Media

company.name: Suno
company.blurb: AI music-creation app letting anyone make songs from a prompt.

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **250 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno is changing who gets to make music, and this role helps bring that to millions of new people. As Creative Strategy Lead, you'll own the creative strategy behind our performance marketing: which audiences we reach, what resonates with each, and how every ad makes us smarter. You'll lead a team of creative specialists, work hand-in-hand with paid media, data science, and production, and build the playbook for how we grow, with full autonomy to shape it.

**Listen to the song we made about it:** https://suno.com/s/wSfvXxWs5tF0RkeL

What You’ll Do

- Own creative strategy for performance marketing across paid social and beyond, from persona strategy to the creative roadmap and the testing plan behind it

- Build a persona playbook that spells out what to say, show, and test for each audience, and keep it current as results come in

- Run the loop from creative analysis to insight to strategy, partnering with paid media and data science on tagging, testing, and reading what drove performance

- Drive audience research, customer conversations, and competitive intel to deepen our understanding of who we bring in, scale what works, and find new audiences worth reaching

- Lead and develop a team of creative specialists across UGC, AI, and brand creative, and manage our UGC agency partner

- Feed what you learn about our users back into product and go-to-market, and help bring millions of new people into creative entertainment

What You’ll Need

- 8+ years in creative strategy, with deep roots in performance marketing

- A track record of paid social creative strategy that drove subscriptions and conversions (not brand or awareness campaigns), with results you can speak to

- Experience at large, complex consumer companies with a wide range of audiences, selling everything from low-price subscriptions to higher-ticket plans

- Experience leading creative strategists and creatives while acting as the bridge between creative and paid media teams

- A sharp, clear communicator who can explain exactly how a strategy is built and why

- Relentlessly proactive: you go looking for the audience insight nobody handed you, and you care deeply about the people you're advertising to

- Bonus: YouTube or Google display creative, ASO, or lifecycle marketing experience

Additional Notes

- Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

- This role requires working onsite at one of our offices.

 

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

- Company Equity Package

- 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

- 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

- 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

- Creative Education Stipend

- Generous Commuter Allowance

- In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

$150,000–$200,000 base salary (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Director, Provider Growth Marketing

company.name: Headway
company.blurb: Microlearning app for book summaries and self-growth, a major mobile UA spender.

description_md:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

**About the Team & Role**

The Provider Growth Marketing team drives acquisition of high-quality providers into Headway's network. They operate across paid and organic channels and own channel, campaign, segmentation, and creative strategy. We're hiring a Marketing Director to lead the team and scale our marketing to be a highly-efficient profit driver across segments and channels. The role reports to the Head of Provider Growth and will be part of the growth leadership team across marketing, product, sales, and operations.

**You Will**

- Drive growth in Headway's provider base and revenue will improving mix and channel metrics to reduce CAC over time

- Own and scale the channel portfolio -paid, organic, lifecycle, referral, and more - testing new channels, strategies, and campaigns to drive new growth

- Hire, coach, and manage the team who run these channels to build their skills and careers

- Drive how we segment and de-average our approach to acquisition and shift toward a more value-based framework

- Reset how we measure our performance

- Partner closely with Sales, RevOps, Finance, and R&D to align on the right growth goals

**You'd be a great fit if…**

- You've personally driven real business growth by leading a marketing organization using multiple channels (SEM, social, organic, lifecycle, referral, etc) at a company with an acquisition machine as large or larger than Headway's

- You have a track record of launching impactful new channels, strategies, and rapid experimentation

- You're fluent in the rapidly evolving states of both SEM/paid social and organic demand generation

- You have experience with multiple approaches to paid acquisition (e.g. CPA, TRoAS, etc) and can be a thought leader for how Headway's approach should evolve

- You're opinionated about how performance marketing should be measured and can drive our approach to evolve

- You've hired, developed, and managed channel managers and ICs and have grown the careers of your people

- You have a track record of collaborating with finance, R&D, and sales, and can be a part of upleveling our practice

We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview.

Headway participates in E-Verify. To learn more, click here.

title: Business Analyst - Growth & User Acquisition

company.name: Wildlife Studios
company.blurb: One of the world's largest mobile game companies, behind Zooba and Tennis Clash.

description_md:
**Help us decide how to scale our games and where to invest to maximize growth! **

We're looking for a Business Analyst - Growth & User Acquisition to help decide how Wildlife should grow its portfolio, scale its player base, and invest our marketing budget. You’ll be part of Product Marketing team at Wildlife Studios.

Our team is where the growth strategy for our games takes shape. We take our titles, put them in front of real players, and ask: how do we make this work at a massive scale? That means figuring out not just who wants to play, but how to find them and acquire them efficiently. You'll work across experimentation, modeling, product analytics, market and distribution strategy, and investment decisions. You'll need to understand the product, challenge assumptions, figure out what the data can actually tell us, and turn that into a clear recommendation: who should we target, how do we reach those players, and how much should we invest?

We work with games across their entire lifecycle, driving growth for titles played by millions. Throughout that journey, the work is the same: understand the product deeply, dig into the data, optimize performance, and figure out the best strategy to distribute and scale it.

If you like working in a dynamic place, digging into complex data to drive strategic investment decisions, and sitting close to the product to build true growth strategies rather than just executing downstream, this is the seat.

**What you'll do**

- **Analysis and experimentation:** Analyze player and game performance across engagement, monetization, and cost of acquisition, turning data into a clear read and recommendation. Help design and evaluate tests, from concept tests to soft launches, and be clear about what the data can and cannot prove.

- **Distribution strategy:** Help shape how a new game reaches players, including which markets, channels, audiences, and creative angles to test and at what cost. Analyze where investment should go across platforms like Meta, Google, and TikTok, and understand what each platform is actually optimizing

- **Support kill, iterate, and scale decisions:** Build the analysis and recommendations behind key product decisions, bringing a clear view of what the data tells us and what we should do next.

- **Modeling under uncertainty:** Work with early LTV, payback, and market-size models where data is limited. Understand the assumptions behind them and use them to inform investment and growth decisions.

- **Launch strategy:** For the games that graduate, help shape how they go global, including which markets open when, how fast to ramp, and how much to invest.

- **Problem prioritization:** New games generate more questions than we can answer. Use judgment to identify the problems and analyses most likely to change a product or investment decision, and proactively drive them forward.

- **Cross-functional teamwork:** Work alongside the game team, product, and creative across a title's whole life. Bring the market and player read into product discussions, including what players are responding to and what the numbers say the game still has to fix. Bring the product reality back into how the game gets positioned and distributed.

**What you'll need**

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills ,  you can explain a model to someone who will never read the code.

- Working proficiency in SQL, plus Python or R.

- Comfort with incomplete data and questions that arrive badly defined.

**Nice to have**

- Familiarity with A/B testing, multivariate testing, and other methodologies for evaluating performance.

- Experience with large datasets, BI tooling, or building data pipelines.

- Previous experience in user acquisition, performance marketing, growth, banking, or consulting.

- Familiarity with the mobile gaming industry landscape.

**More about you**

- Proactive and autonomous; you drive initiatives without waiting for instructions, while ensuring necessary visibility and buy-in from key stakeholders.

- Thrives in high-demand environments and excels at prioritization.

- An exceptional communicator who can influence others ,  including telling a stakeholder their idea won't work, with the data to support it.

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Argentina, Ireland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

Equal Opportunity

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

title: Growth Marketing Manager (Contractor)

At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in...

The Contractor shall provide the following services on an independent, deliverables basis, exercising their own professional judgment, expertise, and methods in performing the Services.

**In this role, you can expect to:**

User Acquisition, Re-Engagement, and Retargeting

- Develop and deliver multi-channel acquisition and retargeting strategies across mobile and PC platforms, tailored to market and audience segmentation, and provide execution plans for Client's review and approval.

- Independently execute and optimize campaigns across advertising platforms (e.g., Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, DSPs, influencer channels) within budgets approved by Client, with the objective of achieving target CPI, ROAS, and LTV benchmarks.

- Apply mobile measurement partner tools (e.g., AppsFlyer) and SKAN 4.0 frameworks to test, measure, and scale iOS campaign performance, and deliver findings and recommendations to Client.

- Deliver attribution analysis, reporting tools, and identification of data gaps in coordination with Client's data resources; provide reporting on channel contribution, LTV projections, and funnel performance.

ASO and Creative Strategy

- Deliver creative strategy recommendations that align paid acquisition campaigns with store page experiences to support growth objectives.

- Prepare creative briefs and deliver project plans for creative asset pipelines, from concept through final delivery, for Client's review.

Cross-Functional Deliverables

- Provide strategic input aligning UA and creative deliverables with Client's product roadmap and live operations, based on information provided by Client's game/product resources.

- Provide ROI assessments and creative alignment recommendations in coordination with Client's marketing, branding, and insights resources.

- Provide channel performance evaluations and LTV validation analysis in coordination with Client's data and finance resources, to inform marketing execution against agreed business metrics.

- Maintain current knowledge of industry trends, platform policy changes (e.g., Apple/Google privacy requirements), and emerging growth technologies, and incorporate relevant developments into deliverables at the Contractor's discretion.

**To be successful in this role, your background includes:**

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

- 3+ years of hands-on growth marketing/UA experience, with a proven track record in mobile gaming or free-to-play app environments.

- Expertise working directly inside self-serve ad platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, DSPs) and Mobile Measurement Partners (MMP, specifically AppsFlyer). Deep understanding of SKAN 4.0 measurement is required.

- Experience running ASO test plans (App Store Connect, Google Play Console, or third-party ASO tools) and managing creative briefing/vendor workflows.

- Strong data analysis skills; ability to design A/B tests, interpret complex funnel data, and extract actionable insights to optimize campaign spend.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting campaign results and performance narratives to cross-functional stakeholders.

- Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.

title: Motion Designer - Mobile Games (Freelance)

company.name: Homa
company.blurb: Mobile games publisher (hyper/hybrid-casual).

description_md:
**Homa** is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Contract setup:** This is a **long-term, full-time opportunity**. While we are looking for someone to join the team on an ongoing basis, the contractual arrangement will be **B2B/freelance only**.

The opportunity

You'll join the creative team and report to a Creative Producer. Day-to-day, you'll work with creative developers and other motion designers to produce UA video ads and playable creatives for our games. This is a hands-on, high-output production role. You'll be measured on the volume, speed, and craft of what you ship, and on how much your AI workflow lifts the team's output.

What you'll do

- **Produce.** Animate and edit UA video ads for mobile games, from concept to final export, in all the formats and aspect ratios the ad networks need.
- **Scale with AI.** Run an AI video pipeline that turns one concept into dozens of variations: new hooks, characters, backgrounds, endings, and pacing.
- **Localize.** Swap text, voice, visuals, and cultural details fast, so one winning creative can run in many markets.
- **Iterate.** Turn performance feedback from the Creative Producer and UA team into new versions within hours, not days.
- **Build playables with AI.** Produce and iterate playable ad creatives using an AI-assisted workflow, from concept to testable build, and keep video and playable creatives consistent.
- **Improve the pipeline.** Test new AI tools and models, document what works, and share workflows that make the whole team faster.

**Why Homa**

- **Exceptional growth.** We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
- **Real ownership, early.** Your projects will change how Homa operates, and you'll see the results.
- **Learn from leadership.** You'll work alongside leaders and people who make decisions.
- **A high talent bar.** Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.

Motion Designer

Le rôle

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un·e **monteur·euse vidéo intermédiaire axé·e sur la performance** pour se joindre à notre studio créatif. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez directement à la création et au montage de publicités vidéo **d'acquisitition d'utilisateurs (UA)** à fort potentiel de conversion et visuellement percutantes, diffusées sur les réseaux sociaux payants et les canaux programmatiques (Meta, YouTube, Unity, etc.).

En collaboration étroite avec les Motion Designers, les stratèges créatifs et les gestionnaires de l’acquisition d’utilisateurs, vous monterez et assemblerez des contenus vidéo combinant des séquences UGC, des mécaniques de gameplay mobile, de la typographie cinétique et des animations graphiques soignées afin de soutenir la croissance du nombre d’utilisateurs. Vous êtes curieux·se, avez la capacité à vous adapter et vous êtes stimulé·e par la façon dont les choix créatifs peuvent avoir un impact direct sur la performance des publicités.

Ce que vous ferez

**Montage vidéo de A à Z :** Monter, rythmer et peaufiner des publicités vidéo courtes, conçues d’abord pour le mobile et adaptées aux canaux de marketing de performance (formats 9:16, 16:9 et 1:1).

**Itérations créatives et tests A/B :** Partir de concepts performants et créer rapidement différentes variantes en testant les accroches d’ouverture, les séquences de gameplay, la conception sonore, les textes superposés et les appels à l’action (CTA), afin de limiter la fatigue créative et d’améliorer la performance des campagnes.

**Assemblage et préparation des contenus :** Importer, organiser et préparer les séquences vidéo brutes, les contenus de créateur UGC, les enregistrements d’écran, les éléments graphiques statiques et les pistes audio pour assurer un processus de montage fluide.

**Collaboration interfonctionnelle :** Collaborer avec les stratèges créatifs, les rédacteurs et les Motion Designers pour transformer les briefs de campagne en livrables à fort impact, liés à des indicateurs de performance comme le CPI, l’IPM et le ROAS.

**Veille sur les tendances et les plateformes :** Rester à l’affût des tendances en montage sur les réseaux sociaux, des formats natifs TikTok, des bandes-annonces de jeux au rythme soutenu et des styles de montage viraux.

Ce que nous recherchons

**2 à 4 ans d’expérience professionnelle** en motion design et en montage vidéo, idéalement dans le marketing d’applications mobiles, la publicité axée sur la performance ou un environnement d’agence numérique.

**Maîtrise d’Adobe Creative Cloud :** Très bonne connaissance pratique de Premiere Pro et After Effects, ainsi que de bonnes compétences avec Photoshop et Illustrator pour la préparation des éléments graphiques.

**Passion pour le jeu mobile :** Un réel intérêt pour les jeux mobiles et une bonne compréhension du langage visuel propre au jeu mobile, du cadrage UI/UX et du rythme du gameplay.

**Curiosité pour la performance :** Envie de comprendre les données derrière la performance créative et de voir comment le cadrage, les accroches initiales et le rythme visuel influencent la rétention et la conversion des utilisateurs.

**Sensibilité au son et au rythme :** Bonne oreille pour le montage audio, le positionnement des effets sonores (SFX) et l’utilisation de la typographie cinétique pour créer de l’énergie dans des vidéos courtes conçues pour le mobile.

**Portfolio / reel solide :** Un portfolio ou reel démontrant une excellente maîtrise du montage vidéo, une typographie animée dynamique, un bon sens du rythme et du contenu numérique visuellement engageant.

Atouts

Familiarité avec les outils de création assistée par l’IA (Midjourney, Runway, Photoshop Generative Fill) pour accélérer la préparation des éléments créatifs.

Expérience de base avec les éléments 3D, Cinema 4D ou Blender, ou encore avec les formats de publicités jouables (playable ads).

title: Performance Marketing Manager, Forecasting & Market Intelligence

description_md:
Scopely is looking for a **Performance Marketing Manager, Forecasting & Market Intelligence,** to join our Performance Marketing team in Canada on a remote basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day, whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating across the games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

The Performance Marketing team helps drive sustainable player growth across Scopely’s portfolio. This role will sit at the intersection of performance marketing, forecasting, competitive intelligence, and market research, supporting active and upcoming Slate titles as they move from early planning through testing, soft launch, and global launch.

What You Will Do

You will build the analytical foundation behind UA forecasts and growth plans: identifying the right comparable titles, developing market and geo assumptions, maintaining benchmarks, tracking competitive signals, and turning incomplete information into structured first-pass recommendations. This is a highly analytical role for someone who enjoys working through ambiguity and can challenge, validate, and refine assumptions rather than taking inputs at face value.

- Develop first-pass performance marketing forecasts and supporting inputs for upcoming Slate titles, including install curves, geo-tier views, channel assumptions, paid and organic assumptions, and launch phasing.

- Build and maintain relevant comparable game-peer sets based on genre, monetization model, platform, geo mix, audience, launch strategy, creative approach, and expected scale.

- Develop and maintain dCPI benchmarks and degradation curves, combining Scopely historical performance, partner benchmarks, competitor data, and external market signals.

- Support organic forecasting by developing assumptions around baseline organic demand, paid-driven lift, launch/IP halo, virality, and organic-to-paid ratios.

- Build sensitivity analyses that make the impact of key assumptions clear and help teams understand the range of potential outcomes.

- Track competitor UA investment, creative trends, app-store movement, channel activity, launch performance, and regional signals across relevant games and genres.

- Produce recurring market-intelligence and competitive-pulse readouts that identify meaningful changes in the market and potential implications for Slate titles.

- Incorporate learnings from market research, beta acquisition, creative and audience testing, soft launch, and other pre-launch signals into forecast assumptions.

- Support regional opportunity sizing and geo strategy, including differences in acquisition cost, scale, organic potential, and market dynamics.

- Maintain clear assumption logs, source documentation, version history, confidence levels, and open questions so forecasts are auditable and reusable.

- Partner closely with Performance Marketing, Product, Strategic Marketing, Finance, Analytics, and other stakeholders to gather inputs and pressure-test assumptions.

- Proactively identify gaps, risks, or inconsistencies in forecasts and surface them before they become downstream planning issues.

- Support ad hoc Slate analyses and leadership requests with structured research, quantitative analysis, and clear first-pass readouts.

- Help improve and standardize forecasting methodologies, benchmark libraries, and analytical processes across Slate over time.

What We’re Looking For

- Strong experience in performance marketing, growth, marketing analytics, strategy, market intelligence, or a similarly analytical role, ideally within mobile games, mobile apps, or another consumer digital business.

- Strong understanding of mobile user acquisition fundamentals, including CPI, LTV, ROAS, retention, organic acquisition, channel mix, attribution, and marginal economics.

- Excellent analytical skills and the ability to turn incomplete or ambiguous information into structured assumptions and useful recommendations.

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills, including building and auditing analytical models, sensitivity analyses, and forecast frameworks.

- Strong attention to detail and a high bar formodel integrity, source quality, and assumption validation.

- Ability to independently pressure-test data and assumptions rather than accepting outputs at face value.

- Experience working with multiple data sources, including internal performance data, third-party market intelligence tools, partner benchmarks, and competitive research.

- Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong cross-functional working style and comfort partnering with teams across Marketing, Product, Finance, Analytics, and leadership.

- Curiosity about the games market and a desire to understand why titles grow, why acquisition economics differ, and how launch dynamics evolve over time.

- Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and operate effectively with limited oversight.

- Comfortable using AI and other analytical tools to accelerate research and analysis, while maintaining independent judgment and thoroughly validating outputs.

Bonus Points

- You are an avid gamer who understands products from a user’s perspective.

title: Senior Manager, Organic Growth

company.name: Mistplay
company.blurb: Montreal loyalty platform for mobile gamers, spanning UA and engagement.

description_md:
Mistplay est l'application de fidélité n°1 pour les joueurs mobiles. Notre communauté de millions de joueurs mobiles engagés utilise Mistplay pour découvrir de nouveaux jeux et gagner des récompenses. Les joueurs sont récompensés pour le temps et l'argent qu'ils consacrent aux jeux et peuvent échanger ces récompenses contre des cartes cadeaux. Mistplay a pour mission d'être le meilleur moyen de jouer à des jeux mobiles pour tous, partout dans le monde ! Téléchargez Mistplay sur le Google Play Store ici et suivez-nous sur Instagram, Twitter et Facebook.

📍 **Veuillez noter :** Au Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay suit un modèle hybride de 2 jours/semaine en bureau à Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montréal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

Mistplay is the #1 loyalty app for mobile gamers. Our community of millions of engaged mobile gamers come to Mistplay to discover new games to play and earn rewards. Gamers are rewarded for their time and money spent within the games and can redeem those rewards for gift cards. Mistplay is on a mission to be the best way to play mobile games for everyone everywhere! Download Mistplay on the Google Play Store here and follow us on Instagram, Twitter and Facebook.

**📍 Please Note:** In Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay follows a 2 days/week in-office hybrid model in Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montreal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

Mistplay is seeking a strategic and hands-on Senior Manager of Organic Growth to help build and scale the organic acquisition engine for our fast-growing rewarded gaming platform. This person will own key levers that bring users to Mistplay outside of paid media, including organic social, referral, promo code programs, and new organic growth opportunities. The mandate is clear: identify what can meaningfully drive organic installs, test it rigorously, and scale the channels and programs that work into a durable, compounding source of growth.

This is a highly cross-functional builder role for someone who thinks like a growth marketer, operates with the rigor of a performance marketer, and is energized by cracking growth problems that do not yet have an obvious playbook. You will lead an internal team and external agency partners while working closely with performance marketing/UA, product, brand, and analytics to make organic growth a measurable, forecastable pillar of Mistplay's overall growth strategy.

**What You'll Do**

Own and execute the organic growth roadmap. Translate Mistplay's broader growth strategy into clear priorities, experiments, and targets for organic acquisition, and own reporting that ties performance to DNU, CAC offset, and retention goals.

Lead social media strategy, team, and agency management. Own Mistplay's organic social strategy across priority platforms end to end; directly manage the internal social media team and supporting social and creative agencies, setting priorities, briefs, workflows, and a high quality bar for content that drives measurable growth.

Crack referral as a core growth lever. Design, launch, and continuously optimize Mistplay's referral program, including its incentive structure, mechanics, and viral loop. Partner with product and engineering to remove friction and drive a step-change in referred growth.

Find and scale new organic growth levers. Build a disciplined pipeline of organic growth opportunities beyond social and referral, develop clear hypotheses and tests, and turn the strongest ideas into repeatable programs. Stay close to emerging consumer behaviors, platforms, partnerships, content formats, and product-led loops that could unlock meaningful growth.

Build and scale promo code strategy. Own promo and referral code programs as a lever for acquisition, reactivation, and retention, defining incentive economics and test structures, partnering with finance and UA on cost and ROI, and building safeguards against abuse and fraud.

Partner cross-functionally to embed organic growth into the broader growth strategy. Work closely with performance marketing/UA, product, brand, creative, and analytics to connect organic initiatives to paid strategy and the full user journey, from acquisition through retention.

Manage budget, tooling, and reporting for organic growth. Own the organic growth budget and vendor and tooling stack, track results with rigor, and clearly communicate impact, learnings, and next steps to senior leadership.

Build sweepstakes into a scalable organic growth lever. Partner with brand, creative, product, legal, and analytics to develop compelling sweepstakes concepts and mechanics that drive acquisition, engagement, and sharing, while continuously testing and measuring their incremental impact.

**What You Bring**

6–8+ years of growth, performance, lifecycle, or organic marketing experience, including direct, hands-on ownership of organic acquisition channels such as referral, organic social, content, community, partnerships, or promotions. Mobile app or gaming experience is strongly preferred.

A proven track record identifying, testing, and scaling at least one meaningful organic growth lever, with measurable impact on acquisition, engagement, or retention metrics.

Experience designing and running referral, promo code, or incentive-based growth programs, including the economics, measurement, and fraud and abuse considerations behind them.

People and vendor management experience. You've directly managed team members and external agencies or vendors, setting clear priorities, briefs, budgets, and performance expectations.

Strong analytical and business case skills. You're comfortable building ROI models for organic investments, partnering closely with analytics, and using data to decide what to scale, refine, or stop.

Strong cross-functional leadership. You can align partners across product, UA, brand, creative, analytics, and finance, influence without direct authority, and communicate recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.

A test-and-learn builder mindset. You are comfortable starting with ambiguity, creating a structured experimentation plan, moving quickly on the levers that show promise, and stopping the ones that do not.

**Nice to Have**

**Experience in mobile gaming, rewards, or loyalty-based apps.**

Hands-on experience building or scaling an organic growth loop and evaluating relevant growth tooling, such as referral, attribution, social listening, community management, or experimentation platforms.

**Experience managing sweepstakes, promotions, or incentive programs** in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment.

**Description Français: **

Mistplay recherche un gestionnaire principal de la croissance organique stratégique et pratique pour aider à bâtir et à développer le moteur d'acquisition organique de notre plateforme de jeux récompensés à forte croissance. Cette personne sera responsable des principaux leviers qui attirent des utilisateurs vers Mistplay en dehors des médias payants, notamment les médias sociaux organiques, les programmes de parrainage, les codes promotionnels et les nouvelles opportunités de croissance organique. Le mandat est clair : identifier ce qui peut stimuler de manière significative les installations organiques, le tester rigoureusement et faire évoluer les canaux et programmes qui fonctionnent vers une source de croissance durable et cumulative.

Il s'agit d'un rôle de bâtisseur hautement interfonctionnel pour quelqu'un qui pense comme un spécialiste du marketing de croissance, opère avec la rigueur d'un spécialiste du marketing de performance et est stimulé par la résolution de problèmes de croissance qui ne disposent pas encore d'un modèle établi. Vous dirigerez une équipe interne ainsi que des agences partenaires externes tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le marketing de performance/acquisition d'utilisateurs (UA), le produit, la marque et l'analyse de données afin de faire de la croissance organique un pilier mesurable et prévisible de la stratégie globale de croissance de Mistplay.

**Vos responsabilités**

Détenir et exécuter la feuille de route de la croissance organique. Traduire la stratégie de croissance globale de Mistplay en priorités, expérimentations et objectifs clairs pour l'acquisition organique, et assumer la responsabilité des rapports associant les performances aux objectifs de nouveaux utilisateurs quotidiens (DNU), de compensation du coût d'acquisition client (CAC) et de rétention.

Diriger la stratégie sur les médias sociaux, l'équipe et la gestion des agences. Prendre en charge de bout en bout la stratégie sociale organique de Mistplay sur les plateformes prioritaires; gérer directement l'équipe interne des médias sociaux et les agences de création et de gestion sociale partenaires, en définissant les priorités, les briefs, les flux de travail et des normes de qualité élevées pour un contenu générateur de croissance mesurable.

Développer le programme de parrainage comme levier de croissance clé. Concevoir, lancer et optimiser continuellement le programme de parrainage de Mistplay, y compris sa structure d'incitatifs, ses mécaniques et sa boucle virale. Travailler en partenariat avec les équipes produit et ingénierie pour éliminer les frictions et générer une accélération marquée de la croissance par recommandation.

Trouver et faire évoluer de nouveaux leviers de croissance organique. Bâtir un pipeline discipliné d'opportunités de croissance organique au-delà des médias sociaux et du parrainage, élaborer des hypothèses et des tests clairs, et transformer les meilleures idées en programmes récurrents. Rester à l'affût des comportements émergents des consommateurs, des plateformes, des partenariats, des formats de contenu et des boucles axées sur le produit qui pourraient débloquer une croissance significative.

Élaborer et faire évoluer la stratégie de codes promotionnels. Détenir les programmes de codes promotionnels et de parrainage comme levier d'acquisition, de réactivation et de rétention, en définissant l'économie des incitatifs et les structures de test, en collaborant avec les finances et l'acquisition d'utilisateurs sur les coûts et le retour sur investissement (ROI), et en mettant en place des garde-fous contre les abus et la fraude.

Collaborer de manière interfonctionnelle pour intégrer la croissance organique dans la stratégie globale. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le marketing de performance/UA, le produit, la marque, la création et l'analyse de données pour connecter les initiatives organiques à la stratégie payante et à l'ensemble du parcours utilisateur, de l'acquisition jusqu'à la rétention.

Gérer le budget, les outils et les rapports de croissance organique. Gérer le budget de croissance organique ainsi que le portefeuille de fournisseurs et d'outils, suivre les résultats avec rigueur et communiquer clairement l'impact, les apprentissages et les prochaines étapes à la direction.

Faire des tirages au sort un levier de croissance organique évolutif. Collaborer avec les équipes de la marque, de la création, du produit, des affaires juridiques et de l'analyse pour développer des concepts et mécanismes de tirages au sort attrayants qui stimulent l'acquisition, l'engagement et le partage, tout en testant et mesurant continuellement leur impact incrémentiel.

**Profil recherché**

6 à 8 ans et plus d'expérience en marketing de croissance, de performance, de cycle de vie ou organique, incluant une gestion directe et pratique de canaux d'acquisition organique tels que le parrainage, les médias sociaux organiques, le contenu, la communauté, les partenariats ou les promotions. Une expérience dans les applications mobiles ou le jeu vidéo est fortement préférée.

Un historique éprouvé dans l'identification, le test et le déploiement à l'échelle d'au moins un levier de croissance organique significatif, avec un impact mesurable sur les métriques d'acquisition, d'engagement ou de rétention.

Expérience dans la conception et la gestion de programmes de parrainage, de codes promotionnels ou d'incitatifs à la croissance, incluant leur modèle économique, leur mesure et la prise en compte de la fraude et des abus.

Expérience en gestion de personnel et de fournisseurs. Vous avez géré directement des membres d'équipe ainsi que des agences ou fournisseurs externes, en fixant des priorités, des briefs, des budgets et des attentes de performance clairs.

Fortes compétences analytiques et d'élaboration de dossiers d'affaires. Vous êtes à l'aise pour élaborer des modèles de ROI pour les investissements organiques, travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe d'analyse de données et utiliser les données pour décider des initiatives à déployer, affiner ou interrompre.

Fort leadership interfonctionnel. Vous savez aligner des partenaires du produit, de l'acquisition d'utilisateurs, de la marque, de la création, de l'analyse et des finances, exercer une influence sans autorité directe et communiquer clairement des recommandations aux parties prenantes principales.

Esprit de bâtisseur axé sur l'expérimentation. Vous êtes à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté au départ, sachant créer un plan d'expérimentation structuré, progresser rapidement sur les leviers prometteurs et délaisser ceux qui ne le sont pas.

**Atouts**

**Expérience dans les applications de jeux mobiles, de récompenses ou de fidélité.**

Expérience pratique dans la création ou l'optimisation d'une boucle de croissance organique et dans l'évaluation d'outils de croissance pertinents (parrainage, attribution, écoute sociale, gestion de communauté ou plateformes d'expérimentation).

**Expérience de la gestion de tirages au sort, de promotions ou de programmes d'incitatifs** dans un environnement réglementé ou soumis à des exigences de conformité.

title: Senior User Acquisition Manager

company.name: Wooga
company.blurb: Berlin casual games studio (June's Journey), part of Playtika.

description_md:
**Our Story**

Founded in 2009, we’re one of the world’s leading game studios, and proud of our extremely international team, consisting of more than 50 different nations. We are part of Playtika and the global leader in the category of Hidden Object Games. With June’s Journey, we’re providing joy for millions of players around the world every day.

**How we work**

Our aim is to keep doing so for many more years, if not decades. In order to be able to do so, we’ve defined a distinct way of how we’re working at Wooga, so that all relevant aspects intertwine and have a positive impact on the game. No matter if you’re part of a game team or support the success of Wooga as part of a central team, all 250+ employees from around the world can make an impact. We’re proud of the environment we’ve built, and believe you’ll enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry.

Our drivers: Speed, Focus, Ownership, and Impact, guide our working style at Wooga and help us make a deliberate choice to focus on what is important to us, while working towards a shared goal.
These drivers shape how we work together and what we expect from ourselves and our leaders.

We are seeking an analytical, enthusiastic marketing professional to join us as a Senior Customer Acquisition Manager. In this role, you will own the marketing budget for our games and partner with various teams to develop and execute a data-driven user acquisition and growth strategy. You will spend millions of dollars per month across multiple platforms in pursuit of Wooga’s user acquisition goals, while continuously identifying opportunities to improve performance through testing, experimentation, and innovation.

A key part of the role is to continuously develop and test new hypotheses across channels, audiences, creatives, and the user journey, turning insights and data into actionable experiments and scaling successful learnings. You will work closely with Creative Production, Product, Analytics, and other teams to develop and test new ideas that drive acquisition and overall game growth. In addition to managing UA campaigns, you will support the marketing team’s internal analysis pipeline, producing regular reports and insights for executive management and the wider marketing team.

**About the role**

- Take responsibility for allocating our marketing budget for your respective networks. Participate in high-level strategic discussions on growing our games and determining the size and allocation of our budgets.

- Develop and continuously evolve UA strategies through ongoing testing and experimentation. Proactively identify opportunities, formulate hypotheses, design tests, analyze results, and scale successful learnings across markets, platforms, and campaigns.

- Collaborate internally with the User Acquisition team as well as externally with the Playtika organization to share knowledge and drive best practices across teams.

- Advance our internal tools and processes using dedicated engineering and analytics resources.

- Strengthen our relationships with advertising partners, including Applovin, Google, and others.

- Identify and evaluate creative growth opportunities for global expansion.

- Partner closely with the Creative Production team to develop, test, and iterate on creative concepts, translating UA insights and performance data into new creative hypotheses and opportunities.

- Work closely with Product, Analytics, Ad Monetization and other teams to identify and test opportunities that can improve acquisition, conversion, retention, and overall growth.

- Support game teams through structured experiments and advise Product teams on features and improvements that can positively impact user acquisition and growth.

- Foster a culture of experimentation by continuously challenging existing approaches, bringing new ideas to the table, and turning insights into actionable tests.

**About you**

- Relevant prior work experience in mobile games or apps (gaming experience is a big plus).

- A professional background in quantitative analysis.

- Up to date on current marketing trends, tools, and consumer behavior.

- You can juggle multiple projects simultaneously, and use data to figure out what's actually working.

- You proactively spot issues before they become problems, and don't wait around for someone else to flag them.

- You bring your own ideas to the table, back them up with data, and know how to find consensus.

- You are comfortable collaborating closely with people from different disciplines, prioritizing the best idea over being right.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

**Please note: Research has shown that some under-represented groups in the gaming industry (eg: women) tend to apply only if they meet every single requirement. Here at Wooga, the desire to learn and the willingness to solve problems are more important to us than your experience on paper. We encourage you to apply even if you do not think that you tick all the boxes - thinking outside of such boxes and embracing the diversity of mindsets and backgrounds is what we believe makes our teams thrive.Our Promise    **

- Shape the future! Challenge the status quo and team up with a diverse group of experts (over 50 nationalities!) working on crafting the world’s best games.

- We offer a generous relocation package and home search support if you are not already located in Berlin. Did we mention that we also cooperate with Kindergartens?

- Make use of a significant education budget and extra days off for self-development. Join our meet-ups, talks, brown bag lunches, internal trainings, workshops and many others.

- Enjoy the yoga, mindfulness app, sports and transport subsidies. And a Purpose Day to donate your time to a worthy cause!

- Did you know that German is the third most commonly taught language worldwide? Learn it too! We offer German language classes for you and your significant other.

- With our hybrid work model you will work in the office with your teams twice a week, to encourage in-person collaboration and team bonding The other three days you can choose if you want to work from home or from the office. We also offer 10 days a year to work from abroad.

At Wooga we are committed to providing a friendly, safe and welcoming environment for everyone who works here or with us, regardless of gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, religion (or lack thereof) and game preferences. Be yourself, we like you that way!

By clicking “Submit Application” you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy

description_md:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Meet the team!

Organic Growth builds sustainable, compounding growth engines for Preply. Within the team, Product Led Growth and Pricing & Discounting are two strategic areas with the potential to unlock non-linear growth, improve learner lifetime value and strengthen the economics of our marketplace.

Product Led Growth already has a dedicated cross-functional product team, including Product, Design, Analytics and Engineering. Pricing and Discounting is the next area of strategic development, with further product investment planned as part of Preply's growth agenda.

You will report to the Senior Director of Organic Growth and take responsibility for agreed commercial KPIs across both areas. This high-visibility role offers the opportunity to scale an established growth engine while building Preply's approach to Pricing and Discounting from the ground up. It is a full-time role based in Barcelona, combining regular collaboration in our office with the flexibility to work remotely.

**What you’ll be doing:**

- Use quantitative and qualitative insight to identify strategic and tactical growth opportunities, challenge assumptions and turn complex analysis into clear recommendations.

- Build alignment across senior stakeholders and communicate strategy, trade-offs, progress and recommendations with clarity and conviction.

- Lead and develop the Product Led Growth analyst, setting a high bar for analytical quality, commercial impact and effective partnership with cross-functional teams.

What success looks like:

- A clear, prioritised Product Led Growth plan that delivers measurable progress against NSGMV, share of NSGMV and efficiency targets.

- An aligned Pricing & Discounting strategy with defined principles, priority opportunities and a sequenced roadmap covering both tutor and learner dynamics.

- High-potential Pricing & Discounting opportunities validated through robust business cases, proofs of concept or MVPs, creating confidence in where Preply should invest next.

- Demonstrable progress towards improving total lifetime value, margin and LTV to CAC efficiency through better pricing, discount and incentive decisions.

- Strong confidence and alignment across Growth, Product, Finance, Data and senior leadership, supported by concise communication and transparent trade-offs.

- A high-performing analyst with clear ownership, strong development and increasing impact on business and product decisions.

What you need to succeed:

- 8 or more years of relevant experience in growth strategy, commercial strategy, pricing, monetisation, business operations or a related role within a product-led technology business.

- Evidence of owning meaningful commercial KPIs for a growth area, business unit, channel or product, and of translating strategy into measurable business impact.

- Strong commercial judgement and a solid understanding of lifetime value, margin, unit economics and the trade-offs involved in growing a two-sided marketplace.

- Excellent strategic and critical thinking, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, make clear choices and move effectively from analysis to execution.

- Experience working directly with Product, Engineering, Data and Finance teams to shape roadmaps, design experiments and deliver complex cross-functional initiatives.

- Strong analytical fluency and the ability to interrogate complex data, evaluate experiments and distinguish meaningful signals from noise. Hands-on SQL experience is helpful but not required.

- Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to build alignment and communicate concise recommendations to senior leaders.

- Experience leading, coaching or developing analytical talent, with the ability to create clarity and raise the quality of a team's work.

- Practical fluency with AI tools, with evidence of using them to improve analysis, research, decision-making or operational workflows.

Experience that would be valuable:

- Direct experience in pricing, monetisation, promotions, discounts, incentives or marketplace economics.

- Experience in a consumer marketplace, subscription business, travel, e-commerce or another scaled digital product with complex pricing and lifetime value dynamics.

- A background that combines structured strategy or consulting experience with hands-on operating ownership.

Why you’ll love it at Preply:

- An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

- A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;

Our Principles

description_md:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Mission**

As a Growth Specialist, you'll play a key role in driving the performance of our live mobile game portfolio. You will work at the intersection of social trends, creative strategy, and AI-powered execution ,  turning what’s working on TikTok and social platforms today into growth momentum for our games tomorrow.

Your main responsibilities will include:

- **Hunt and translate trends** ,  monitor TikTok, ad libraries, and social platforms daily to surface high-potential hooks and turn them into actionable creative strategies for assigned games
- **Own your games** ,  manage growth execution on your assigned live titles, track performance, identify opportunities, and iterate fast based on results
- **Build smarter with AI** ,  use AI tools every day to analyze data, automate workflows, and find new ways to move faster and think bigger
- **Execute with precision** ,  collaborate with the UA and Product teams to launch and optimize test campaigns that drive measurable uplift
- **Push the bar** ,  bring fresh energy, creative thinking, and a relentless desire to find what works ,  then do more of it

This is a great opportunity to own real games from day one, build your growth toolkit in an AI-first environment, and fast-track your career at one of Europe’s most ambitious mobile gaming companies.

**Requirements**

We are looking for someone with a first experience in growth, creative content, or social media, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You’re a great fit if you have:

- **A sharp eye for trends** ,  you live on TikTok, you know what’s going viral and why, and you can connect dots from social culture to a game’s audience
- **An AI-native mindset** ,  you already use AI tools to get things done faster, build processes, and experiment with new approaches without being asked
- **Energy and ownership** ,  you don’t wait to be told what to do; you identify the next thing and go after it
- **A creative, outside-the-box approach** ,  you think differently about problems and get excited by testing new ideas
- **Strong communication skills** ,  you can work across teams, explain your thinking clearly, and align people around a direction

Bonus points if you have:

- Previous experience in ad creatives, performance marketing, or social content production
- Basic exposure to mobile UA, growth hacking, or community building
- Knowledge of tools like Meta Ad Library, UA8, or similar trend/analytics platforms

Even if you don’t check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we’re more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

**Our Culture**

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

- **Humility:** We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
- **Curiosity:** We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
- **Focus:** Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
- **Ambition:** We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

**Benefits**

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

- **🏥 Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
- **🏢 Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
- **🌍 Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
- **🌐 Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
- **✈️ Team Gatherings:** We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
- **📈 Performance Reviews:** We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
- **💻 Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you’re working remotely.

**Where We Hire**

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you’re based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

title: Organic Growth Hacker - Paper.io 2

company.name: Voodoo
company.blurb: Paris-based mobile games and apps publisher, one of the largest hypercasual and hybrid-casual UA operations in the world.

description_md:
**About Voodoo**

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

**Team**

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

Paper.io 2 is one of Voodoo's biggest games: 100M+ downloads and a top-ranked arcade title. It's simple, competitive and oddly satisfying, and it's played mostly by Gen Alpha (middle school / early high school).

**Role**

We're not looking for a community manager or a social media manager who posts three times a week and hopes for the best.

We're looking for a **growth hacker who uses social media as their playground**. You don't wait for the algorithm; you find ways to game it. You'd rather launch 100 accounts to see which 3 blow up than polish a single post for a week. You know the tricks, the loopholes and the formats nobody has tried yet, and you test them before everyone else does.

**Your one mission:** make Paper.io 2 massively viral on TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram, measured in views, engagement and virality.

- **Build an account machine:** Launch and run a network of accounts: niche pages, personas, gameplay clips, languages, AI-produced content. Scale the ones that win and kill the rest fast.

- **Use AI as a weapon:** Produce, remix and test content at a volume a traditional team can't match, with AI video, voice, editing and automation.

- **Hijack trends in hours, not weeks:** Spot sounds, formats and IRL trends rising among Gen Alpha, and turn them into PO2 content before they peak.

- **Hack distribution:** Seeding, comments, stitches and duets, fan accounts, cross-posting, and boosts on winning posts. Every post gets a plan to spread.

- **Activate creators and collabs:** Find creators big and small, set up collabs, and turn players into content creators through challenges, UGC and in-game hooks.

- **Test everything, all the time:** Hooks, formats, first frames, posting times, accounts. Read the data, double down on what works, cut the rest.

- **Report what you learn.** Every week: what blew up, why, and what you're scaling next.

**Profile**

- You've already grown accounts or brands on TikTok/Shorts, and you can show numbers (your own accounts count, and often count more).

- You think in **volume, speed and iteration**, not perfection.

- You have a bag of tricks: algorithm hacks, growth loops, tools, automation, and you're always looking for more.

- You're fluent in AI tools for content production and scale.

- You get Gen Alpha culture: what's cool, what's cringe, what moves fast.

- You can edit short-form videos yourself, quickly.

- You're data-driven: you know what hold rate, shares per view and completion rate tell you.

- You're comfortable on camera (a plus).

**Why join**

- One of the biggest mobile games in the world as your sandbox

- Real freedom to test unconventional ideas

- Resources to scale what works: tools, AI, creators, paid boosts

- A direct line to the UA, creative and game teams

**Benefits**

- Best-in-class compensation

- Other benefits according to the country you reside

This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

- **Own way more, way earlier** ,  you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

- **Push harder, get further** ,  this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

- **Join a rare environment** ,  you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

- **Fully present** ,  we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

UA Manager

Salary range: €55,000-80,000/annum. Final salary will be assessed according to your skills.

We're looking for a **Paid Social Manager** to take ownership of our core app user acquisition channels. This is a high-stakes, hands-on role built for someone who lives in the data, moves fast on optimizations, and knows how to scale app campaigns across AppLovin, Facebook, and TikTok.

You'll be managing significant budgets across live campaigns ,  this is not a planning role. It requires daily attention, sharp instincts, and the ability to diagnose and fix performance problems in real time.

**What You'll Do 🎯**

- **Own App UA at Scale:** Take ownership of app install campaigns across AppLovin, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, and DSPs - managing $500k+ in daily spend and optimizing toward revenue and predictive LTV targets.

- **Drive Daily Performance:** Monitor live campaigns daily, make proactive budget and bid adjustments, and troubleshoot performance drops without waiting to be asked.

- **Lead Creative Strategy:** Analyze top-performing creatives and competitive trends, identify what's working on TikTok and Facebook, and plan a balanced production mix of iterations and new concepts.

- **Manage a Creative Ecosystem:** Coordinate with our internal creative team - briefing, reviewing, and prioritizing production to keep testing pipelines moving.

- **Navigate Attribution Complexity:** Work across multiple campaign types, manage cross-channel attribution windows and settings, and use Adjust MMP to ensure clean app tracking and accurate performance reads.

- **Build Toward LTV:** Set and optimize against primary KPIs rooted in revenue and predictive lifetime value - understanding not just surface metrics but the downstream signals that predict real business impact.

**What You'll Bring 💡**

- **App UA Track Record:** Proven experience scaling app install campaigns across at least two of: AppLovin, Unity, Snapchat, Facebook, TikTok, or programmatic DSPs - with meaningful budget responsibility.

- **Spend-Scale Comfort:** You've managed large daily budgets in a live environment and know how to operate with both precision and speed when campaigns are actively running.

- **Creative Judgment:** You can analyze performance data to identify what creative is working, brief agencies effectively, and plan a testing roadmap that balances iteration with new concepts.

- **Attribution Fluency:** Solid understanding of mobile attribution, MMP setup (Adjust preferred), and how different campaign types and attribution windows interact ,  especially across app and web.

- **LTV & Revenue Focus:** Experience optimizing toward revenue-based KPIs and predictive LTV, ideally in gaming or subscription apps. If you don't have gaming background, you need to clearly demonstrate you understand the metrics that drive performance downstream.

- **Problem-Solving Operator:** You diagnose, you act, you iterate. You don't wait for weekly reviews to catch a problem ,  you're in the account daily and you fix things before they become fires.

**What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟**

- You treat a live campaign like it's always your responsibility - proactive, not reactive.

- You think in signals and ratios, not just top-line spend.

- You're a confident stakeholder manager who can align internal teams and external agencies toward a shared creative and performance roadmap.

- You're comfortable with complexity - multiple campaign types, channels, and attribution layers - and you build clarity from it rather than getting slowed down by it.

**Why Almedia? 🎁**

- **Scale With Almedia:** Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

- **Central Berlin Office:** Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

- **Other Benefits:** Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

description_md:
