Our values guide us, and our mission drives us. Come join us and help deliver financial wellness for the whole family, putting the tools of wealth-making into everyone’s hands.

____________________________________________________________

Growth Marketing, Sr. Associate - New Channels | Acorns

Acorns is looking for a curious, driven Growth Marketing Sr. Associate to join our team and help expand our paid acquisition channel mix. You will work closely with the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager to research, launch, and scale emerging platforms, from programmatic DSPs to community-based channels like Reddit, driving user growth across Acorns and Acorns Early.

This role carries real ownership. You’ll operate with meaningful day-to-day autonomy, exercise judgment within established frameworks, and produce analysis and recommendations that shape how we invest in new channels. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Analytics, Creative, and channel partners to bring experiments to life and move quickly from proof of concept to scaled channel.

Acorns is a **remote-first organization**, offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA.

What You Will Do

**Channel Testing & Execution**

- Help develop and execute a structured testing roadmap for new and emerging paid media channels, including programmatic display, Reddit, Snapchat, and other alternative platforms.

- Own day-to-day campaign management across existing channels like Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit, and YouTube

-  Run tests on new channels, including setup, trafficking, pacing, and ongoing optimization.

- Use performance data and judgment to make in-channel optimizations, escalating broader strategic decisions to the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager as needed.

- Partner with the Creative team to brief, test, and iterate on ad assets tailored to each platform and audience.

**Measurement & Reporting**

- Identify incrementality and lift study opportunities, collaborate with the Analytics team to design the test structure, and own the launch and ongoing performance monitoring of each experiment.

- Track and report on key performance indicators for new and existing channel initiatives, translating data into clear summaries for internal stakeholders.

- Maintain organized records of test results, learnings, and optimization actions to build a shared knowledge base for the team.

**Cross-Brand & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Support acquisition growth across our brand portfolio, Acorns and Acorns Early.

- Work collaboratively with Analytics, Creative, and other marketing teammates to execute experiments efficiently and surface actionable insights.

- Actively monitor the AdTech landscape, including gaming platforms (e.g., Roblox, Discord), community platforms, and emerging programmatic DSPs, and bring forward channel opportunities for the team to evaluate.

What You Will Bring

- 3+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid media, or growth marketing with a BS/BA; or equivalent work experience.

- Hands-on experience with at least one paid media platform (e.g., Meta, Snapchat, Reddit, The Trade Desk, or similar).

- Familiarity with mobile measurement platforms (e.g., Adjust, AppsFlyer) and an understanding of how attribution frameworks inform paid media decisions. Exposure to Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) is a plus.

- A data-driven mindset, you’re comfortable working with performance data and translating numbers into clear, actionable takeaways.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; you follow processes carefully, flag questions early, and aren’t afraid to modify your approach when the situation calls for it.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, you can summarize experiment results and share channel recommendations in a way that’s easy for stakeholders to act on.

- Genuine curiosity about where digital advertising is heading and a hunger to explore channels competitors aren’t using yet.

- A belief that your work is connected to something bigger, helping everyday people build financial security is core to what we do at Acorns, and we want teammates who are energized by that mission.

You are not expected to have experience with every platform listed. If you’re passionate about Acorns’ mission and eager to grow in performance marketing, we encourage you to apply.

**What we offer:**

- Competitive salary and stock options

- A comprehensive benefits package for you and your family

- Flexible work location, hours, and paid time off

- 401(k) matching

- Monthly Acorns account contribution & GoHenry account for your family

- Mindfulness and Financial Wellness resources, Headspace and Addition Wealth

- Acorns Career Development Program (Ongoing training sessions, development plans, development check-ins, Cornerstone’s online training platform)

- Roots Leadership Program for Emerging Leaders

- Community week onsite gatherings and various virtual events

- Talented and motivated team members who care deeply about one another, our mission, and our customers.

- The rare opportunity to create a new world. We inspire one another every day to do meaningful work that solves big societal challenges.

**About Acorns:**

Acorns is the financial wellness company helping everyday Americans grow their money for the long term. Since 2014, Acorns has grown into a global company with multiple life stage products serving the needs of kids, teens, adults and parents. Named one of America's Best Financial Services of 2026 by TIME, Acorns has served over 16 million people, and helped customers save & invest over $33 billion dollars, much of it from spare change and small amounts.

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including equity grants, and discretionary cash bonus awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who is a true specialist in paid social performance marketing. You’ll manage our paid social campaigns end-to-end: platform partnerships, testing and measurement, driving web and app conversions at scale across markets.

This is a role for someone who has done this at real scale: you've managed paid social budgets of $30M+ annually, you understand attribution deeply, and you bring rigor, curiosity, and sharp analytical instincts to everything you touch. You should be comfortable digging into the data yourself ,  building your own analyses, spotting issues before anyone asks, and translating numbers into clear action. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

You're also a builder, not just an operator. When a workflow is slow or a test framework doesn't exist yet, you build it rather than waiting for someone else to. You think like a creator: better tests, sharper creative, smarter systems. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

We made a song about the role: https://suno.com/s/owdc28Zl5z3YqWbN

What You’ll Do

- **Own Paid Social channel performance globally: **manage campaigns optimizing for web and app conversions, subscriptions, and growth KPIs across multiple geographies and markets. Evaluate and pilot new platforms and formats as they become relevant.

- **Drive full-funnel results: **manage budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing to consistently hit CPA and ROAS targets at scale

- **Manage platform partnerships: **own the relationship with paid social channel reps, including beta access, product roadmap input, billing, and spend reconciliation.

- **Own analysis and reporting: **run proactive weekly performance analyses, using Excel and other tools to diagnose trends and surface opportunities. Design and run incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies) to confirm spend is driving net new users, not just capturing demand that would have converted anyway.

- **Navigate app campaign complexity: **own tracking setup (Conversions API), MMP integration (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust, etc.), and mobile attribution nuance across platforms

- **Build your own tools: **when something is broken or needs improvement, build the fix yourself. Write the script, build the dashboard, design the smarter test framework. - **Partner with creative & across the business: **own all creative analysis and give structured feedback on ad creative, brief new concepts, and drive iteration based on performance data. Work with lifecycle/CRM, product, data science, and finance to align on audience strategy, budget, and measurement.

- **Own budget and forecasting: **manage pacing across campaigns and markets, proactively reallocating spend to what’s working

- **Communicate with clarity: **translate complex campaign data into sharp insights and recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders

- 3+ years hands-on managing conversion-optimized paid social campaigns (must have specific paid social channel experience) with multi-million annual budget responsibility across major platforms

- Strong grasp of web conversion campaigns ,  pixels, events, landing page performance, and full-funnel optimization

- Experience running global campaigns across multiple geographies and markets

- Experience with app campaign mechanics and mobile attribution (MMPs like Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust; SKAdNetwork, postbacks, etc.)

- Sharp analytical skills: advanced in Excel, including pivot tables, with a track record of proactively running weekly and ad hoc analyses to diagnose performance and drive decisions ,  not just reporting on results, but getting ahead of them

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where channels, tools, and strategy evolve constantly

- Nice to have: experience across a broad range of paid channels beyond the major social platforms (such as, X, Snapchat, Pinterest)

Additional Notes

- Must be willing to work 5 days/week in-office.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

- 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

- 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

company.blurb: AI-powered answer engine and fast-growing consumer app.

description_md:
**About the role**

We're looking for a Senior Motion Designer to own motion graphics and GTM video output across Perplexity's social channels. Video is one of our most important channels for telling the Perplexity story, and we want someone whose primary focus is producing a steady stream of high-quality, on-brand motion work that performs.

This is a video-production-first role. You'll spend most of your time concepting, animating, and shipping GTM materials for social ,  fast, polished, and distinctly Perplexity. In a secondary capacity, you'll help define our motion principles and contribute to broader creative technologist work as our motion practice matures.

You'll report into the Brand/Creative Studio team and work closely with Brand, Growth, Comms, and the Producer to keep the pipeline moving.

**What you'll do**

- Own the creation of motion graphics and video content for our social channels ,  concepting, storyboarding, animating, and delivering GTM materials end-to-end

- Make video production your primary focus: a consistent, high-volume output of polished, on-brand motion work

- Bring ideas to life across 2D and (where relevant) 3D, from styleframes and animatics to final delivery

- Partner with Brand and Growth to turn launches and campaigns into motion that lands on social

- Contribute to Perplexity's motion principles, systems, and templates so motion scales consistently across the team (secondary focus)

- Contribute to broader creative technologist explorations ,  new tools, techniques, and AI-assisted workflows (secondary focus)

- Collaborate with the Producer on scoping, scheduling, and delivering work on time

**What we're looking for**

- Senior-level experience in motion graphics and animation, with video production as your core craft

- A strong portfolio of expressive motion work ,  especially social, campaign, and GTM content that demonstrates range and polish

- Deep command of animation fundamentals: timing, spacing, composition, visual rhythm, and design sensibility

- Expert proficiency in After Effects and the broader Adobe Creative Suite; comfort in Figma

- Ability to work fast, manage multiple deliverables, and iterate quickly in a high-output environment

- A strong sense of when motion adds clarity or emotion ,  and when a still is the better choice

**Nice to have**

- Experience developing motion principles, systems, or toolkits that scale across a team

- Comfort across 2D and 3D, plus compositing, post-production, and optimization for different social platforms

- Creative technologist instincts ,  building or experimenting with tools and AI-assisted motion workflows

- Graphic design fluency (layout, hierarchy, type) sufficient to build and adapt assets directly

**Profile**

**Benefits**

- Swile Lunch voucher

- Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

- Wellness activities in our Paris office

title: Growth Marketing Manager - TV

company.name: Rocket Money
company.blurb: Personal-finance app (formerly Truebill) helping people manage subscriptions and save.

location: Remote (US), New York City, NY, San Francisco, CA, Washington DC.
description_md:
**ABOUT ROCKET MONEY 🔮**

Rocket Money’s mission is to empower people to live their best financial lives. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

**ABOUT THE ROLE 🤹‍♀️**

Reporting to the Director of Growth, this role is responsible for executing Rocket Money's TV acquisition strategy across Linear and Streaming TV. You will own the day-to-day execution, analysis, and optimization of our TV media buying, turning strategy into results. You'll partner closely with the Director of Growth and cross-functional teams to sharpen measurement, test new tactics, and continuously improve performance. This is an opportunity to make an immediate, measurable impact on Rocket Money's growth. We are in a hyper-growth phase and expanding how we think about TV, from a performance-first engine toward a blended performance and brand strategy. In this role, you'll help accelerate velocity, unlock new scale, and raise the bar for how we approach growth marketing.

**IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL:**

- **Drive TV Channel Performance:** Own day-to-day media buying, optimizations, pacing, and post-buy analysis across Linear and Streaming TV, ensuring we consistently hit CPA, CAC, and ROAS targets.

- **Optimize Spend For Efficiency and Impact:** Identify high-potential pockets, apply repeatable playbooks, and scale winning tactics across networks and publishers.

- **Manage Budget and Forecasting:** Own weekly pacing and forecasting for TV, monitor spend effectiveness and ROAS, and surface findings with actionable recommendations.

- **Analyze and Optimize Relentlessly:** Dive deep into campaign performance data to surface insights, identify winning networks, publishers, and formats, and translate learnings into actionable optimizations.

- **Design and Run Experiments:** Execute a structured testing roadmap for TV, developing clear hypotheses and success criteria for individual tests and translating results into actionable learnings.

- **Treat Creative As A Performance Lever:** Partner with the Creative team to brief, test, and iterate on TV creative, and turn testing insights into a stronger, higher-performing creative library.

- **Manage Agency and Vendor Partners:** Work closely with our TV buying and measurement partners to plan, execute, and optimize campaigns, holding them to a high bar.

- **Strengthen Measurement:** Collaborate with Data, Product, Engineering, and CRM to improve attribution, unlock growth levers, and ensure data quality across campaigns.

- **Communicate Performance and Insights:** Contribute to regular reporting on TV channel performance, sharing key wins, learnings, and recommendations with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

- **Improve Systems and Processes:** Contribute to Rocket Money's culture of curiosity by identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, enhance tracking, and build scalable processes as the TV program continues to grow.

- **Stay Ahead of the Space:** Track industry trends, identify first-to-market opportunities, and share learnings across the team.

- **Ensure Brand Safety and Compliance:** Uphold brand safety, regulatory compliance, and privacy standards in all media activity; collaborate with Legal/Compliance as needed.

**ABOUT YOU 🦄**

- 4+ years of experience in TV media buying at a high growth consumer company, startup, or agency, with hands-on experience across Linear and/or Streaming/CTV.

- Strong analytical foundation with fluency in core growth and efficiency metrics such as CAC, ROAS, LTV to CAC, and blended performance.

- Ability to turn data and experiment results into clear recommendations and action.

- Experience coordinating across internal teams and external partners or agencies.

- A holistic view of the marketing funnel and an understanding of the role each channel plays.

- Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and making fast decisions with imperfect information.

- Familiarity with TV measurement approaches like incrementality testing, media mix modeling, and attribution, and how to apply findings to channel strategy. Bonus points if you've worked with Haus.

- Naturally curious with a strong inclination to question assumptions and validate ideas through data and experimentation.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel. Experience with Looker or similar analytics tools is a plus.

**WE OFFER 💫**

- Health, Dental & Vision Plans

- Life Insurance

- Long/Short Term Disability

- Competitive Pay

- 401k Matching

- Team Member Stock Purchasing Program (TMSPP)

- Learning & Development Opportunities

- Tuition Reimbursement

- Unlimited PTO

- Daily Lunch, Snacks & Coffee (in-office only)

- Commuter benefits (in-office only)

Additional information: Salary range of $115,000 - $140,000 + bonus + benefits, based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skill, and experience.

title: Motion Designer Lead

description_md:
Scopely is looking for a **Motion Design Lead** to join our Marketing Creative Services team, Flamed, in our **Barcelona office** on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day, whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world.

We are Flamed, the in-house creative agency, an international multidisciplinary team. We produce thousands of creatives each year to support the global marketing needs of all Scopely games. In this role, you will lead a team of artists working across the **Scopely Explore** portfolio, formerly known as **Niantic**, including **Pokémon GO**, **Monster Hunter Now**, and **Pikmin Bloom**. Depending on business needs, you may also support other IPs within Scopely’s extensive portfolio.

What you will do:

- Lead and oversee motion design projects for Scopely Explore portfolio, from concept through final delivery.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with creative directors, producers, and internal/external artists to ensure quality, consistency, and on-brand execution.

- Provide artistic and technical direction on motion design, animation, and compositing.

- Review and guide vendors to ensure alignment with the visual identity and performance goals of the brands.

- Mentor and support internal artists, helping develop their creative and technical growth.

- Contribute to visual development, style frames, and storyboards, setting the artistic tone for each piece.

- Work with an attention to detail attitude in a constructive cross-feedback environment.

What you will need:

- 7+ years of experience in motion design, animation, or related fields, with at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.

- An excellent **video reel** that demonstrates expert-level motion design and animation.

- Proficient in the standard tools of the trade: After Effects, Cinema 4D, Octane Render Engine and Photoshop.

- Excellent art direction, storytelling, and visual taste.

- Solid understanding of team coordination in creative environments.

- Excellent communication skills in English.

- A collaborative mindset and passion for creative excellence.

- Passionate of mobile games, especially **Pokémon GO**, **Monster Hunter Now**, and **Pikmin Bloom** is a plus.

Bonus Point:

- Hands-on experience using **Unreal Engine** to produce cinematic-quality renders.

- Additional knowledge of **Unity** is a plus.

- Strong understanding of Social Media, Performance Marketing, and User Acquisition creatives.

- Proactive interest in AI-assisted design tools and their creative applications.

***To be considered for this role, please submit your CV and showreel with your application. A showreel is an essential requirement, and if available, you may also include a portfolio.About Scopely**

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry ,  bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team ,  including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses ,  Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good ,  creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

title: Creative Strategist

company.name: AppLovin
company.blurb: Mobile app growth and monetisation platform with its own portfolio of apps and games.

description_md:
About AppLovin

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

**About the Role**
Gist is a new consumer social app built by AppLovin, a handbook for the curious. We're building our creative engine from the ground up, and we're looking for a Creative Strategist who lives at the intersection of storytelling and performance data.

In this role, you'll own the creative strategy behind our paid social advertising. You'll concept, brief, and iterate on ads that are genuinely enriching, while staying deeply connected to the metrics that determine what scales.
Central to this is your ability to identify, brief, and collaborate with top creators to produce authentic content that resonates at scale.

This is a hands-on seat. You're not handing briefs to an agency and reviewing decks. You're in the work.

**A Day in the Life**

- Identify, recruit, and manage relationships with strong creators whose audiences and content style align with Gist's voice ,  curiosity-driven, enriching, and  relevant

- Brief creators to produce authentic, platform-native content that performs as paid social without feeling like an ad

- Develop creative concepts, write scripts, and direct editors to produce 10+ ad variants weekly across Meta, TikTok, Google, and other paid social channels

- Build and run a structured creative testing framework ,  hooks, formats, CTAs, audience angles ,  and translate performance signals into the next hypothesis

- Analyze CVR, CPI, CPA, and ROAS data to identify what's working and brief the next round of creative accordingly

- Partner with the performance marketing manager to connect creative decisions directly to acquisition outcomes

- Stay ahead of content trends, platform formats, and creator behavior to keep our creative fresh and competitive

**The Impact You'll Make**

- Build the creative foundation that drives Gist's early user growth and brand presence

- Establish a scalable creator network and data-driven creative testing system from scratch

- Influence how Gist shows up across paid social at a critical zero-to-one moment

- Help define what enriching, curiosity-driven advertising looks like in a noisy feed environment

**Who You Are**

- 3–5 years in paid social creative strategy, with Meta Ads as your primary channel

- Proven track record working directly with top creators ,  you know how to identify the right talent, build the relationship, and get the best work out of them

- Deep understanding of what makes creator content feel authentic versus forced, and how to translate that into high-performing paid social

- Quantitative by nature: you measure creative success in CVR lifts, CPA deltas, and ROAS impact, not just aesthetics

- A portfolio of creator-led campaigns that both performed and that you're proud of creatively

- Able to write a script, direct a shoot, or cut a rough edit

- Comfortable with AI tools like Claude Code or Cursor is strongly preferred

- Consumer app or DTC brand background strongly preferred

description_md:
Who are we?

**TripledotStudios** is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who **LOVE** making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

**The role is working within our studio: Lion Studios**

Lion Studios is a mobile games publisher that works with mobile developers to get their games discovered by players around the world. Headquartered in San Francisco, Lion Studios’ creative and strategy teams utilize their expertise to help game developers break through the noise and grow their businesses.

Since launching in 2018, Lion Studios has driven 90% of its games to the Top 10 in the App Store and Google Play and helped drive 16 games to #1 in the US App Store’s Top Free chart.

**Role Overview**

As our **Ad Monetisation Analyst**, you’ll take ownership of the ad monetisation strategy for a diverse portfolio of games, guiding them from their initial prototype phase all the way to a full launch. Your responsibilities will include building and optimizing ad waterfalls, managing all ad monetisation setups, and conducting A/B tests to continuously improve performance. You will be expected to consistently generate and test new ideas for monetisation innovations.

A key part of the role is to foster strong relationships with external partners to secure the best deals and ensure robust business relations. Internally, you will work closely with the product and growth teams to ensure a cohesive strategy and maximize ad revenue across the portfolio..

**Key Responsibilities**

- Own ad monetisation strategy for a portfolio of games: build, optimize, and manage monetisation setups to maximize revenue across Lion Studios.

- Design and execute monetisation-related product decisions.

- Lead integration, testing, and rollout of new monetisation partners.

- Manage relationships with ad providers.

- Propose and drive new monetization initiatives, partnering with engineering to scope and build the solutions behind them

- Track eCPM, fill rate, ARPDAU, and other core KPIs, and report performance and insights to Product, UA, and leadership

- Serve as a primary point of contact for ad network ,  technical troubleshooting, escalations, and holding partners accountable to commitments

- Comfort designing and reading A/B tests with statistical rigor

- Collaborate with Product, QA, and User Acquisition teams to share insights, enhance workflows, and drive efficiency

**Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

- More than 3  years of experience in ad monetisation in gaming.

- Hands-on experience with MAX mediation platform.

- Ability to adapt quickly to new tools, dashboards, or analytical frameworks.

- Self-sufficient, autonomous, and able to juggle multiple projects in a fast-changing environment.

- Knowledge of Looker for analytics and reporting is a plus

title: Creative Producer

company.name: Wildlife Studios
company.blurb: One of the world's largest mobile game companies, behind Zooba and Tennis Clash.

description_md:
We are looking for a Creative Producer to join the Creative Strategy team at Wildlife. This is a role for someone who has spent their career making audiovisual work ,  writing, directing, producing ,  and who wants to apply that craft to advertising creative that runs at scale and is measured every day.

You will own the creative production pipeline for one or more of our games, working alongside Product Marketing Managers and our in-house Creative Studio team. You create and prioritize the ideas that get produced, and you stay close enough to production to make sure the idea survives execution.

You are accountable for the quality of the creative that goes out for the games under your scope, and for finding whatever you need to get there: pulling numbers, asking PMMs and Game Directors, studying what competitors are running, and using AI to move faster through research, benchmarking, and analysis.

What you'll do

You will generate creative concepts for the games under your scope and carry them from idea to script. You will work from competitor benchmarks, market and network trends across media channels, player signals, and performance results, and turn that material into a line of ideas the team can produce. We expect ideas that go further than the reference that inspired them.

You will write scripts and briefs that the Creative Studio and external providers can build from. You will direct production across video, playable, and static pieces, with a point of view on treatment, pacing, edit, and animation approach, reviewing cuts until the ad delivers what the idea promised. You will bring taste and creative judgment to the work, critiquing, refining, and holding the quality line.

You will read creative performance across metrics like Spend Share, IPM, CTR, CPI, ROAS, hook and hold rates, and use that read to decide what to iterate, what to scale, and what to abandon. You will follow test methodologies with PMMs and Data Scientists, and document learnings into the team's structured knowledge base, so insight compounds across creatives, games, and time.

What you'll need

- A senior track record in audiovisual production or creative direction ,  in a production company, an in-house studio, an agency, or as an independent director.

- A portfolio of work you directed or produced. This is the main input we will evaluate, and we will ask you to walk us through the decisions behind specific pieces.

- Scriptwriting as a practiced craft, from concept to shooting or animation script.

- Experience directing animation and motion work, enough to brief it, critique it, and correct it.

- Openness to go deep on performance marketing logic and metrics. Prior experience is welcome, and what we ask for is the willingness to learn it: digging into results, understanding why a creative won or lost, and using that to adjust the next round.

- Comfort with AI as part of daily workflow. You do not need to be technical, but you need to engage with AI tools as leverage.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, in English and Portuguese.

Nice to have

- Experience in mobile gaming or app marketing.

- Experience with playable ads, or with interactive formats.

- Familiarity with market intelligence tools (Sensor Tower, AppMagic, or similar) used to extract competitive insight.

- Experience running or reading structured A/B tests on creative.

More about you

- You have taste. You can tell good from great and you can articulate why.

- You generate ideas under pressure, in volume, without the quality dropping as the count goes up. Given a product, an audience, and a deadline, you can put a range of concepts on the table and defend the reasoning behind each one.

- You are curious about the market by default. You watch what works, you track competitors, you keep a running library of references without being asked.

- You are pragmatic about iteration. You do not get attached to your ideas. You get attached to learning.

title: Growth Marketing Manager, Conversion

company.name: Suno
company.blurb: AI music-creation app letting anyone make songs from a prompt.

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **250 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

 

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert ,  and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

 

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself ,  grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R

What You'll Do

- Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them

- Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves

- Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding

- Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions

- Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast

- Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand

- Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why

- Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context

- Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic

- Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting

- Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn

Qualifications

- You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you

- 5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO)

- You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them

- You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next

- You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar

- You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business

- You use AI to get more done than one person normally could

- You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days/week at our office in NYC or LA

Compensation

$160k - $185k base salary (before equity)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

- Company Equity Package

- 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

- 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

- 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

- Creative Education Stipend

- Generous Commuter Allowance

- In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

title: Head of Performance Marketing

company.name: Supercell
company.blurb: Helsinki studio behind Clash of Clans, Clash Royale and Brawl Stars.

description_md:
Lead the marketing engine behind some of the world's most iconic mobile games.

We’re looking for a Head of Performance Marketing to join Supercell – someone who combines strategic capability and clarity, technical depth, and people-first leadership. You’ll lead our Performance Marketing function, including world-class Performance Marketing teams, ASO, and CRM, driving growth for some of the world’s most iconic mobile games while enabling a talented team to do their best work.

You’ll be deeply embedded in the business by balancing creative ambition with operational excellence, and turning data, technology, and insight into growth.

You will lead a talented team responsible for driving user acquisition and cross-media operations across Supercell’s live and future games. Our Performance Marketing team operates both centrally and embedded within game teams – you’ll need to set direction and enable success across both models, building the systems and culture that empower the team wherever they sit.

This is a role for someone who leads with clarity and empathy, sees the bigger picture without losing sight of impact, and navigates complex organizations with diplomacy and confidence. You’ll partner closely with leaders and teams across Game teams, Marketing, Data & Analytics, Finance, and Creative Production to ensure our media strategies drive long-term growth and business impact.

We pride ourselves on the level of thoughtfulness, quality, and focus put into every aspect of our work. Be it the games themselves or how we communicate them to our players, we are passionate about not compromising on quality ever and choosing a long-term approach to make Supercell a truly global games company that will last for many decades to come.

Let us know if you are who we are looking for!

**What You'll Be Doing**

- Shape the strategic vision and direction for Supercell’s Performance Marketing function, ensuring alignment with company and game-level business goals. Drive cross-functional alignment through openness, integrity, and collaboration – ensuring clarity of direction across marketing, analytics, and operations.

- Lead and develop a high-performing team of Performance Marketing, ASO, and CRM professionals; setting clear goals, fostering autonomy, and creating an environment where people do their best work.

- Build and maintain measurement frameworks, governance structures, and operational systems that enable the team to perform at their best, alongside coaching and culture that help individuals grow.

- Build strong partnerships with Game Leads, Marketing Leads, Data, and Finance to ensure marketing investment decisions are data-informed, scalable, and business-driven.

- Oversee media strategy and governance – ensuring that Supercell’s global marketing efforts are effective, efficient, and future-proofed against evolving market dynamics.

- Own CRM as a strategic growth lever – ensuring lifecycle and retention strategy is tightly integrated with user acquisition, game-level priorities, and long-term business goals.

- Embrace AI curiosity and capability – comfortable working with AI-powered campaign tools and platforms, you understand how algorithms make decisions and how to work with them, not just around them. This includes using AI for workflow automation, creative production, and campaign optimization, while staying honest about the trade-offs involved.

- Push boundaries. Take bold bets. Own risks and back your team when it counts.

**What you have**

- Extensive leadership experience in performance marketing and media or operations with a proven track record of leading high-impact, high-scale teams in complex, global organizations.

- Deep understanding of performance marketing and user acquisition, with the ability to translate complex technical and data-driven concepts into strategic direction. This includes a strong grasp of product dynamics and the interaction between UA and product – understanding how marketing decisions shape and are shaped by the player experience and game economy.

- Player-first mindset. You believe great marketing ultimately serves the player experience, not just the metrics.

- Portfolio-level experience managing marketing investment across multiple products at different lifecycle stages, with the ability to allocate, prioritize, and adapt strategy as games grow, mature, or launch.

- Strong business and financial mindset, able to connect marketing performance to commercial outcomes and broader company goals.

- Fluent in data and analytics, with the ability to guide strategic decision-making in collaboration with data science and analytics teams.

- Exceptional stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing senior leaders and aligning diverse perspectives around shared priorities.

- Diplomatic and emotionally intelligent, with the ability to lead through trust, clarity, and empathy – even in ambiguity.

- A builder of people and culture, passionate about coaching, growing, and empowering others to succeed.

- Passion for games and building systems that last.

- A self-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

**Where You'll Be**

This role can be based either in Helsinki or London. The team members are located in both our Helsinki and London Studios; however, most of our team members and stakeholders are located in Helsinki!

To be successful, you'll be expected to travel regularly in this role, especially if based out of London.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

**About Supercell **

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

**Hey, You Might Love It Here!**

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

**You Are Not Your Job Title ™**

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

**Benefits and Compensation **

At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

**Advertiser Customer Growth Associate ,  Growth Marketing**

We have a long list of brands that should be advertising with us and aren’t. Your job is to get ahold of them ,  no matter what ,  and get them live.

**The problem**

AppLovin’s self-serve ads platform is growing fast, and the pipeline is bigger than the team working it. Most of these brands already know us: they signed up and got stuck somewhere in the process, or they ran campaigns and stopped. Some are fresh outreach. Either way, nobody has picked up the phone and gotten them over the line. That’s the job.

**What you’ll do**

- Work a ranked daily queue of high-value brands. Reach the decision-maker by phone, email, LinkedIn ,  whatever it takes. Three ignored emails is the start, not the end.

- Find out what’s in the way: they never finished setup, something broke, or they just haven’t heard a good reason to start. Then handle it.

- Walk them from first conversation to first live campaign. You own the account until it’s spending.

- Log every touch in HubSpot so we know what works. Your pipeline is measured, not vibes.

- Own one number: advertisers you get live.

**What we’re looking for**

- Grit. You’ve got that dog in you ,  you get people on the phone that other reps gave up on. This matters more than anything on your resume.

- You have an understanding of the role that performance marketing makes of businesses.

- You genuinely like talking to founders and marketers, and they like talking to you.

- Drive. The queue is long, the wins compound, and nobody will push you but the scoreboard.

- You take the time to research accounts and prep outreach.

- Sales or e-commerce background helps, but the product is simple to learn. We care more about how you sell than what you’ve sold.

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **250 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

 

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert ,  and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

 

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself ,  grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R

What You'll Do

- Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them

- Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves

- Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding

- Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions

- Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast

- Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand

- Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why

- Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context

- Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic

- Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting

- Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn

Qualifications

- You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you

- 5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO)

- You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them

- You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next

- You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar

- You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business

- You use AI to get more done than one person normally could

- You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days/week at our office in NYC or LA

Compensation

$160k - $185k base salary (before equity)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

- Company Equity Package

- 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

- 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

- Creative Education Stipend

- Generous Commuter Allowance

- In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

company.name: Duolingo

description_md:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds ,  while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

Read our blog to learn more.

**About the role...**

Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. With over 500 million users and rapid expansion across new subjects and markets, Duolingo's growth trajectory demands world-class analytical leadership. We're hiring a Senior Data Science Manager to lead the data science function within our Growth pillar, one of the most consequential areas of the business.

This person will own all aspects of product data science, forecasting, and business intelligence for User Growth. They will lead a team of 6 to 10 data scientists spanning staff to junior levels, with a mandate to coach, develop, and grow their careers while also expanding the team by hiring exceptional talent over time. The ideal candidate combines deep technical fluency in forecasting, statistical/ML modeling, and experimentation with genuine leadership ability: the kind of person who raises the bar for everyone around them.

This role reports to the Head of Data Science & Analytics and partners closely with cross-functional leadership in Engineering, Product, Design, and Finance.

**🧠  You will...**

- Set the analytical vision and roadmap for User Growth data science, ensuring the team's work is tightly aligned with company-level priorities and pillar-level goals.

- Lead a team of 6 to 10 data scientists. Build a culture of professional growth, intellectual rigor, creative problem-solving, and shipping impact. Grow the team over time by attracting and hiring outstanding talent.

- Support and evolve the practice of embedding Data Scientists within product development teams, simultaneously maintaining strong stakeholder connection and function cohesion.

- Own the design, execution, and interpretation of experiments and analyses that drive decisions on user acquisition, activation, retention, and reengagement. Improve and advocate for the methodological standards that ensure we learn reliably from every test.

- Develop and maintain user growth forecasting systems. Partner with Finance and Product to deliver credible, timely forecasts of key growth metrics and ensure leadership has the quantitative foundation to set targets and allocate resources.

- Drive business intelligence strategy within Growth, including the metrics layer, self-serve dashboards, and the analytical infrastructure that enables others to operate with data fluency.

- Translate complex analytical findings into clear narratives for senior leadership and cross-functional partners. Influence strategic decisions through a combination of technical depth and effective communication.

- Collaborate across organizational boundaries with Product Management, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Finance to elevate every phase of product development.

**✅  You have...**

- Experience using data science and analytics to solve product and business problems.

- Experience managing 5+ person data science teams.

- Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to distill complex quantitative work into crisp, actionable insights for diverse audiences.

title: Creative Strategist, Mobile

company.name: ElevenLabs
company.blurb: AI voice and audio platform powering consumer and creator apps.

description_md:
**About ElevenLabs**

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**

- **High-velocity: **Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- **Impact not job titles: **We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company, from engineering to growth to operations.

- **Excellence everywhere: **Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- **Global team: **We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**

- **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- **Growth paths: **Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- **Learning & development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- **Annual company offsite: **Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- **Co-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

**About the role**

ElevenReader is our fast-growing consumer audio app, and creative is one of our biggest growth levers. We’re looking for a Creative Producer to deliver creative marketing campaigns, experiments, and to build the creative engine that powers performance marketing across every major acquisition channel.

This role sits at the intersection of creative design, AI, and performance marketing. You’ll be our lead creative strategist, producing high-quality creative concepts, building scalable creative workflows using AI tools, developing a testing roadmap, launching experiments across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms with our Performance Marketing team. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Design, Growth Analytics, and partner agencies to continuously discover which creative drives acquisition at scale, and feeding these insights back into future creative roadmaps.

This is one part strategist and one part creative producer for someone who loves combining exceptional creative taste with rigorous experimentation and marketing results.

**What you will do**

- Designing creative systems, concepts and templates, mood boards, briefs, and AI workflows that power high-velocity ad production

- Create visually-stunning, brand aligned, static ad campaigns end-to-end in Figma and ElevenLabs

- Directing agency partners with clear and compelling creative briefs, UGC scripts, storyboards, scripts, and feedback on creative concepts, ensuring the timely and aligned delivery of assets

- Creating and launching creative testing programs across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging acquisition channels with Performance Marketing and agencies

- Developing a structured creative roadmap with recurring testing sprints and clear learning agendas

- Designing analytical frameworks to identify winning creative patterns using performance data and creative analysis

- Researching and mapping creative trends across competitors, consumer categories, and best-in-class mobile apps to generate new hypotheses for testing

- Partnering closely with Performance Marketing and agencies to rapidly iterate and scale winning campaigns

- Continuously improving our creative production pipeline through AI automation, reusable templates, and scalable workflows

- Analyzing which creative is resonating most with our audience through ad platforms and tools like Motion

- Raising the creative quality bar while ensuring every asset is designed to maximize measurable business outcomes

**Requirements**

- 5+ years of experience in performance creative, art direction, growth marketing, creative strategy, or design at a high-growth consumer product or technology company

- Deep expertise with generative AI for image and video creation, with a strong understanding of how to build repeatable creative workflows with tools like ElevenCreative

- Experience creating high-performing ads across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, or other major paid acquisition platforms

- Experience with creative performance analytics tools like Motion

- Strong understanding of creative experimentation, performance marketing, A/B testing, and data-driven optimization

- Expert proficiency in Figma, CapCut, Adobe Suite and modern AI creative tools and generative media platforms

- Exceptional visual taste with the ability to balance speed, quality, and brand consistency

- Deep understanding of user psychology and what drives successful consumer marketing

- Highly analytical and structured thinker who enjoys building experimentation frameworks and extracting insights from data

- Self-directed builder who thrives in fast-moving environments and can independently take ideas from concept to launch

**Bonus**

- Power user of ElevenCreative, including Flows and Templates

- Background in building AI-powered creative production systems or internal creative tooling

- Passion for consumer products, AI, storytelling, and building globally loved brands.

**Location**

This role is remote with a preference for timezones in US - East and Europe

title: Sr. Paid Social Manager

company.name: Suno
company.blurb: AI music-creation app letting anyone make songs from a prompt.

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **200 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who is a true specialist in paid social performance marketing. You’ll manage our paid social campaigns end-to-end: platform partnerships, testing and measurement, driving web and app conversions at scale across markets.

This is a role for someone who has done this at real scale: you've managed paid social budgets of $30M+ annually, you understand attribution deeply, and you bring rigor, curiosity, and sharp analytical instincts to everything you touch. You should be comfortable digging into the data yourself ,  building your own analyses, spotting issues before anyone asks, and translating numbers into clear action. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

You're also a builder, not just an operator. When a workflow is slow or a test framework doesn't exist yet, you build it rather than waiting for someone else to. You think like a creator: better tests, sharper creative, smarter systems. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

We made a song about the role: https://suno.com/s/owdc28Zl5z3YqWbN

What You’ll Do

- **Own Paid Social channel performance globally: **manage campaigns optimizing for web and app conversions, subscriptions, and growth KPIs across multiple geographies and markets. Evaluate and pilot new platforms and formats as they become relevant.

- **Drive full-funnel results: **manage budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing to consistently hit CPA and ROAS targets at scale

- **Manage platform partnerships: **own the relationship with paid social channel reps, including beta access, product roadmap input, billing, and spend reconciliation.

- **Own analysis and reporting: **run proactive weekly performance analyses, using Excel and other tools to diagnose trends and surface opportunities. Design and run incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies) to confirm spend is driving net new users, not just capturing demand that would have converted anyway.

- **Navigate app campaign complexity: **own tracking setup (Conversions API), MMP integration (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust, etc.), and mobile attribution nuance across platforms

- **Build your own tools: **when something is broken or needs improvement, build the fix yourself. Write the script, build the dashboard, design the smarter test framework. You do not wait for someone else to solve it, and you use your best judgement and expertise to make sure the analysis, strategy and execution drives excellent results.

- **Partner with creative & across the business: **own all creative analysis and give structured feedback on ad creative, brief new concepts, and drive iteration based on performance data. Work with lifecycle/CRM, product, data science, and finance to align on audience strategy, budget, and measurement.

- **Own budget and forecasting: **manage pacing across campaigns and markets, proactively reallocating spend to what’s working

- **Communicate with clarity: **translate complex campaign data into sharp insights and recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders

Qualifications

- 3+ years hands-on managing conversion-optimized paid social campaigns (must have specific paid social channel experience) with multi-million annual budget responsibility across major platforms

- Strong grasp of web conversion campaigns ,  pixels, events, landing page performance, and full-funnel optimization

- Experience running global campaigns across multiple geographies and markets

- Experience with app campaign mechanics and mobile attribution (MMPs like Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust; SKAdNetwork, postbacks, etc.)

- Sharp analytical skills: advanced in Excel, including pivot tables, with a track record of proactively running weekly and ad hoc analyses to diagnose performance and drive decisions ,  not just reporting on results, but getting ahead of them

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where channels, tools, and strategy evolve constantly

- Nice to have: experience across a broad range of paid channels beyond the major social platforms (such as, X, Snapchat, Pinterest)

Additional Notes

- Must be eligible to work in the US.

- Must be willing to work 5 days/week in-office.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

- Company Equity Package

- 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

- 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

- 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

- Creative Education Stipend

- Generous Commuter Allowance

- In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for the target level for this role is $145,000 – $170,000 (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

description_md:
**ABOUT CODEWAY**

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale.

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two.

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us.

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Education), Sparked (Media), Cosmic Jam (Entertainment), and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space.

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.

Turns out you can do both.

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.

**
POSITION**

We know that a Associate Marketing Artist is the backbone of a successful marketing campaign. We have the best products and the strongest analytical capabilities in our category. And with you, we’ll have everything we need to scale our success.

That’s why we are looking for a creative and exceptional Associate Marketing Artist who will help us introduce our apps to millions of users around the world.

**
WHAT YOU'LL DO**

- **Craft compelling designs.** Craft visually compelling designs for mobile product-related marketing campaigns, including both motion graphics and static visuals.

- **Collaborate with marketing.** Work closely with the Marketing Team to understand data insights and brainstorm innovative creative ad ideas.

- **Translate initiatives into visuals.** Transform key marketing initiatives into high-quality, consumer-facing visuals that capture attention.

- **Follow trends.** Stay on top of social media trends and the mobile app creative ad industry.

- **Analyze performance.** Analyze performance data from creatives, break down ad performance, and generate improvement ideas.

- **Manage external communication.** Communicate with and brief third-party vendors on visual creation needs, ensuring smooth production processes.

- **Create 2D assets.** Assist in creating eye-catching 2D assets for UA ads and static content.

- **Optimize assets.** Adjust existing assets for different formats and specifications such as resizing, re-layouts, and localizations.

- **Use design tools.** Work with Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro to deliver high-quality outputs.
